exposure: Obstetric and gynecological operations (specifically Cesarean hysterectomy)
Repair techniques for urinary tract injuries (suture type, number of layers, suprapubic catheter use)
outcome: Post-operative complications (admission to intensive care, sepsis, renal failure, maternal death)
cohort: Patients who experienced urinary tract injuries following obstetrical and gynecological procedures at Yarmouk Hospital between 2021 and 2023.
finding: Early intraoperative diagnosis and specific repair techniques (two-layer Vicryle sutures and suprapubic catheterization) are critical for reducing morbidity and enhancing recovery from urinary tract injuries following obstetric operations.
mod_finding: Urinary tract injuries, predominantly bladder injuries (80.65%), were frequently observed following obstetric operations, with Cesarean hysterectomy being the procedure in 54.84% of cases.
